message:
Summary: {
  "USER_CONTEXT": "Generate a single raw input file (PoC) that triggers a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 2 in libsndfile's wavlike_ima_decode_block (crash state: wavlike_ima_decode_block -> ima_reader_init -> wavlike_ima_init). Submit via bash ./submit.sh PATH_TO_POC /workspace/candidate_trace.json. Also produce a fine trace JSON for the exact candidate.",
  "COMPLETED": [
    "Read README.md and description.txt; identified target: libsndfile, fuzz target sndfile_fuzzer, crash type Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 2 in wavlike_ima_decode_block.",
    "Located vulnerable source: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libsndfile/src/ima_adpcm.c (functions wavlike_ima_init, ima_reader_init, wavlike_ima_decode_block).",
    "Analyzed ima_reader_init: buffer allocation pimasize = sizeof(IMA_ADPCM_PRIVATE) + blockalign*channels + 3*channels*samplesperblock; samples buffer = samplesperblock*channels shorts.",
    "Analyzed wavlike_ima_decode_block: 'Pull apart' loop writes to pima->samples[indx] with indx potentially exceeding buffer; decode loop writes to pima->samples[k] for k < samplesperblock*channels.",
    "Examined wav.c and wavlike.c to understand how blockalign and samplesperblock are parsed from the WAV fmt chunk (wavlike_read_fmt_chunk).",
    "Identified the consistency check in ima_reader_init: samplesperblock must equal 2*(blocksize-4*channels)/channels + 1, otherwise SFE_INTERNAL is returned."
  ],
  "PENDING": [
    "Determine the exact overflow condition (likely integer division mismatch or large blocksize causing buffer under-allocation).",
    "Craft a WAV file with IMA ADPCM format (WAVE_FORMAT_IMA_ADPCM = 0x11) that passes the consistency check but triggers the heap-buffer-overflow.",
    "Generate the fine trace JSON for the exact PoC candidate.",
    "Submit both files using bash ./submit.sh PATH_TO_POC /workspace/candidate_trace.json."
  ],
  "CURRENT_STATE": {
    "Working directory": "/workspace",
    "Vulnerable source": "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libsndfile/src/ima_adpcm.c",
    "Key functions": "wavlike_ima_init (line 108), ima_reader_init (line 178), wavlike_ima_decode_block (line 387)",
    "Buffer allocation": "pima->data = samplesperblock * channels shorts; pima->block = data + samplesperblock*channels",
    "Consistency check": "count = 2*(blocksize - 4*channels)/channels + 1; if samplesperblock != count return SFE_INTERNAL",
    "Potential overflow": "In wavlike_ima_decode_block, the 'Pull apart' loop writes 2*(blocksize-4*channels) samples starting at index channels; max index = channels + 2*(blocksize-4*channels) - 1. Buffer capacity = samplesperblock*channels. For channels=1 or 2, max index appears in-bounds when samplesperblock matches count exactly, but integer division may cause mismatch when (blocksize-4*channels) is not divisible by channels.",
    "Submission script": "/workspace/submit.sh (requires POC file and candidate_trace.json)"
  },
  "CODE_STATE": {
    "File": "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libsndfile/src/ima_adpcm.c",
    "Function signatures": [
      "int wavlike_ima_init (SF_PRIVATE *psf, int blockalign, int samplesperblock)",
      "static int ima_reader_init (SF_PRIVATE *psf, int blockalign, int samplesperblock)",
      "static int wavlike_ima_decode_block (SF_PRIVATE *psf, IMA_ADPCM_PRIVATE *pima)"
    ],
    "Data structures": "IMA_ADPCM_PRIVATE (contains samples, block, channels, blocksize, samplesperblock, blocks, blockcount, samplecount, decode_block)",
    "Related files": "wav.c (line 254 calls wavlike_ima_init), wavlike.c (wavlike_read_fmt_chunk parses fmt chunk)"
  },
  "TESTS": {
    "Crash type": "Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 2",
    "Crash state": "wavlike_ima_decode_block -> ima_reader_init -> wavlike_ima_init",
    "Fuzz target": "sndfile_fuzzer",
    "Fuzzing engine": "afl",
    "Sanitizer": "address (ASAN)",
    "Reproducer testcase": "https://oss-fuzz.com/download?testcase_id=6044202054713344"
  },
  "CHANGES": "No code changes made yet; only analysis performed.",
  "DEPS": "No dependencies modified; libsndfile source inspected.",
  "VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS": "Repository: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libsndfile; no git operations performed yet."
}
